name: get_state
description: Returns what the app is doing now: the section on screen, the tuner (listening, tuning, last note heard and how many cents off), the drone (playing, note, added intervals, volume) and the reference A.

name: open_section
description: Shows a section of the app.

name: tuner_start
description: Opens the tuner and starts listening through the microphone. The tuner stops by itself when another section opens or the app goes to the background. Read the result with get_state.

tuning.description: Open strings to tune to; "chromatic" for any note.

name: tuner_stop
description: Stops the tuner and turns the microphone off.

name: set_tuning
description: Chooses the instrument tuning. Double bass: orchestral (E A D G), solo (F# B E A), cExtension, fiveLowB, fiveHighC. Electric bass: fourStrings, fiveStrings, sixStrings, dropD.

name: drone_play
description: Plays the drone, a sustained pure tone to practise intonation on. Any setting given is applied first.

note.description: Note name in English (A, Bb, F#) or Italian (La, Sib, Fa#), optionally with the octave (A2, Sol1). E1 is the double bass low E.

add_fifth.description: Adds a pure fifth above the note.

add_octave.description: Adds the octave above the note.

name: drone_set
description: Changes the drone settings without starting or stopping it.

note.description: Note name in English (A, Bb, F#) or Italian (La, Sib, Fa#), optionally with the octave (A2, Sol1). E1 is the double bass low E.

add_fifth.description: Adds a pure fifth above the note.

add_octave.description: Adds the octave above the note.

name: set_reference_pitch
description: Sets the frequency of A4, shared by the tuner and the drone.
